units.source_text: 别惊讶于我有生以来头一次上青楼就能这样仔细地观察。

en.t: Do not be surprised that, even though this was the first time in my life I had entered a pleasure quarter, I was able to observe everything so carefully.

units.source_text: 我要从自己所观察的东西中，找出快乐的根据来。

en.t: From the things I observed, I meant to find the basis of pleasure.

units.source_text: 所有的一切都像铜版画那样被精密地观察，而且就那样精密地摊平巾在同我保持一定距离的地方。

en.t: Everything was observed with the precision of a copperplate engraving, and in that same precise way it was spread out flat at a place that kept a certain distance from me.
